meta.purpose: Separates verified facts from unverifiable gaps and lists must-answer questions before capital deployment.

verified_facts.statement: 2020, 2025, and 2026 Week 9 NFL standings reconcile 100% (32/32 clubs)
verified_facts.verified_value: 32/32 exact W-L-T & PF/PA match vs live NFL.com after adding 16 post-Nov-1 finals (136 played games thru Wk 9)

verified_facts.statement: Closing market spread beats pure statistical Ridge origination out-of-sample
verified_facts.verified_value: 2023-2026 Wk 8 OOS: Ridge MAE 10.284 vs Market MAE 9.737; residual slope = -0.1453 (p = 0.2280, R^2 = 0.0017)

verified_facts.statement: Zero candidate strategies clear all 10 validation gates
verified_facts.verified_value: 0 of 8 (6 signals + 2 controls) pass; top raw ROIs (S3 +9.20%, S1 +5.36%) fail NIST z (p=0.221/0.295), BH FDR (q=0.437), and EB shrinkage (-2.79% / -2.14%)

verified_facts.statement: Inexperienced backup QBs (<5 career starts) cause steep scoring dropoff, yet market prices most of it
verified_facts.verified_value: Within-season backups (<5 starts, n=438) average 18.13 PPG vs 23.60 PPG incumbent QB1 (-5.47 PPG), yet ATS is 48.47% (-1.17 margin vs spread)

verified_facts.statement: Underlying EPA persists midseason while 1-score wins and fumbles are nearly pure noise
verified_facts.verified_value: 2015-2025 split-half r: Net EPA/gm = 0.4908 vs 1-score win% = 0.0497, Win%-Pyth% = 0.0593, Fumbles lost = 0.0079

verified_facts.statement: Same-game QB & WR1 passing/receiving legs exhibit strong structural correlation
verified_facts.verified_value: QB pass yds <-> WR1 rec yds r = 0.5640 (n=4,482), Copula 2-leg prob 34.54% (+190 fair vs +300 naive)

verified_facts.statement: Live Week 10 REG10 injury table and 9 club depth charts contain documented omissions & stale entries
verified_facts.verified_value: REG10 omits SEA (12 inj), CIN (3 inj), BAL (2 IR QBs), LAC; club DCs include Aaron Donald (LA), omit Parsons (GB), Joseph (DET), Brissett (BAL)

missing_unverifiable.discovery_plan: License or record timestamped prop lines for >= 2 NFL seasons before testing prop ROI.
